say:1:1530143601:0.text: Yes, I'm old. All I've got left is soup and stories.
say:1:1530143601:0.source_cn: 是的，我老了，老的只能喝汤吹牛。
say:1:1530143601:0.male: Yes, I'm old. All I've got left is soup and stories.
say:1:1530143601:0.female: Yes, I'm old. All I've got left is soup and stories.

say:2:1530143602:0.text: But that's exactly why it should be us on the battlefield, not the young ones.
say:2:1530143602:0.source_cn: 可正是如此，去战场的应该是我们这些老人才对。
say:2:1530143602:0.male: But that's exactly why it should be us on the battlefield, not the young ones.
say:2:1530143602:0.female: But that's exactly why it should be us on the battlefield, not the young ones.

say:3:1530143603:0.text: The young shouldn't be the ones dying out there...
say:3:1530143603:0.source_cn: 不能，也不应该让年轻人送死啊……
say:3:1530143603:0.male: The young shouldn't be the ones dying out there...
say:3:1530143603:0.female: The young shouldn't be the ones dying out there...
